common.tagline: A research pipeline where people approve every stage

nav.signOutFailed: Could not sign out. Try again.

login.title: Sign in
login.description: Use the email and password from your lab invitation.
login.help: No account, or forgot your password? Ask a lab admin for a new link.

reset.title: Set your password
reset.description: Choose a password for your account. This link works only once.
reset.hint: At least {min} characters. A short sentence is easy to remember.
reset.tooShort: The password needs at least {min} characters.
reset.mismatch: The two passwords do not match.
reset.invalidDescription: It was already used or it has expired. Ask a lab admin for a new one.
reset.doneDescription: You can now sign in with your new password.

errors.INVALID_TOKEN: This link is invalid or has expired. Ask a lab admin for a new one.
errors.TOKEN_EXPIRED: This link has expired. Ask a lab admin for a new one.
errors.BANNED_USER: This account is suspended. Contact a lab admin.
errors.INVALID_ORIGIN: The request was blocked for security reasons. Reload the page and try again.
errors.MISSING_OR_NULL_ORIGIN: The request was blocked for security reasons. Reload the page and try again.
errors.YOU_ARE_NOT_ALLOWED_TO_CREATE_USERS: Only lab admins can invite people.
errors.YOU_ARE_NOT_ALLOWED_TO_LIST_USERS: Only lab admins can manage users.
errors.TOO_MANY_REQUESTS: Too many attempts. Wait a moment and try again.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.emptyDescription: Create a project, or ask a project owner to add you to theirs.

create.title: New project
create.description: You will be its owner and can add members afterwards.
create.name: Name

budget.title: My LLM budget
budget.noBudget: No paid budget: your runs use free models.
budget.resets: Resets on the 1st of each month (UTC). When it runs out, runs switch to free models.

project.title: Project
project.confidential: Confidential: only providers that keep no data are used, so fewer free models are available.
project.viewerNotice: You are a viewer in this project: you can follow its runs but not start them.

newRun.title: New run
newRun.description: Start the pipeline on a research topic. You approve each stage before the next one starts.
newRun.topicPlaceholder: e.g. Monocular depth estimation on NYU Depth V2

auto.label: Auto
auto.description: Paid models while your budget allows, then free models.

free.label: Free only
free.description: Never spends money. Free models are slower and rate-limited.

newRun.cap: Cost cap for this run (USD, optional)
newRun.capHint: Paid calls stop at this amount; the run continues on free models.

members.title: Members
members.description: People who can see this project.
members.descriptionOwner: Add people with the email they were invited with.

roleHints.owner: Manages members and can approve any run.
roleHints.researcher: Starts runs and approves their own.
roleHints.viewer: Can look, but cannot start or approve runs.

run.title: Run
run.pausedTitle: Paused: the lab's LLM balance is used up
run.pausedDescription: Admins have been alerted. The run resumes when the balance is topped up.

events.title: Live events
events.replayed: reused a response already paid for

approval.title: Review the {stage} output
approval.description: Approve to continue, request changes to get a new attempt, or reject to stop the run.
approval.readOnly: The run owner or a project owner decides on this output.
approval.degradedDescription: The stage could not produce a full result, so this is a fallback or partial placeholder. Check it carefully before approving.
approval.commentPlaceholder: What should change, or what the next stage should know
approval.commentHint: Optional when approving or rejecting; required when requesting changes.
approval.commentRequired: Say what should change before requesting changes.

sent.approve: Approved. The next stage will start.
sent.request_changes: Changes requested. A new attempt will start.

approval.conflictToast: This output changed while you were reviewing it.
approval.conflictDescription: Your decision was not recorded: a newer output replaced the one you reviewed, or someone already decided. Review what is shown now.
approval.updatedDescription: Version {version} replaced the output you were reading. Read it before deciding.
approval.rejectConfirmDescription: Rejecting stops the whole run. This cannot be undone.

cancel.confirmDescription: Work in progress stops and the run cannot be resumed. Money already spent stays charged.

admin.title: Administration
admin.description: Invite lab members, set monthly LLM budgets and control paid models.

link.description: {email} sets a password with this link. It works once and expires in {hours} hours.
link.notEmailed: The email could not be sent. Share the link below yourself, through a private channel.
link.label: Set-password link
link.warning: Until it is used, anyone with this link can take over the account. Do not post it publicly.

invite.title: Invite someone
invite.description: Creates the account and sends a single-use link to set the password.
invite.name: Name

paidModels.title: Paid models
paidModels.description: Kill switch for the whole lab. When off, every run uses free models, whatever the budgets.
paidModels.off: Paid models off: free models only
paidModels.disabledToast: Paid models are off. Runs now use free models only.

users.title: Users
users.description: Monthly budgets are in USD and reset on the 1st (UTC).

auth.required: Your session has ended. Sign in again.
auth.unavailable: The sign-in service is unavailable. Try again shortly.

csrf.origin_mismatch: The request was blocked for security reasons. Reload the page and try again.

permission.denied: You do not have permission to do that.

project.not_found: Project not found, or you are not a member.

user.not_found: No user has this email. Ask a lab admin to invite them first.

stage_output.not_found: That stage output no longer exists.

approval.stale: The output changed since you opened it. Review the latest version.
approval.duplicate: A decision on this output was already recorded.
approval.rejected_by_workflow: The workflow no longer accepts a decision on this output.
approval.expired: Nobody decided in time, so the run was cancelled.

orchestrator.unavailable: The workflow engine is unavailable, so the run could not start. Try again later.

db.unavailable: The database is unavailable. Try again shortly.

stage.error: A stage failed. The event log may say more.
stage.too_many_attempts: The stage was retried too many times (at most 3 attempts).
stage.invalid_output: A stage returned output that does not match its expected format.

lab_balance.exhausted: The lab's LLM balance is used up.

free_models.disabled: This project does not allow free models, and paid models are not available.

free_quota.exhausted: The lab's free-model quota is used up for now. Try again later.

validation.failed: Some fields are not valid. Check them and try again.

network.error: Cannot reach the server. Check your connection.

server.error: The server had a problem. Try again shortly.

stage.placeholder: this stage is not implemented yet, so it returned a stand-in result.

literature.search_pending: the literature search is not connected yet.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.description: The page does not exist, or you do not have access to it.

errorPage.title: Something went wrong
errorPage.description: This page hit an unexpected error.

invite.subject: You're invited to {appName}
invite.body:
Hello {name},

An administrator created an account for you on {appName}. Open this link to choose your password:

{url}

The link works once and expires in {hours} hours. If you did not expect this email, you can ignore it.

reset.subject: Set a new password for {appName}
reset.body:
Hello {name},

Use this link to set a new password for your {appName} account:

{url}

The link works once and expires in {hours} hours. If you did not ask for this, you can ignore this email.
